Matthias Loy: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Matthias Loy (1828–1915) · Hymn writer and translator

3 hymns on NoteFusion credit Matthias Loy. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • The Gospel Shows the Father's Grace

    The Gospel shows the Father's grace,

    Doh is F6/4Tune: HERR JESU CHRIST, DICT ZU UNS WENDSolfa PDF

  • The Law of God Is Good and Wise

    The law of God is good and wise,

    Doh is G4/4Tune: ERHALT UNS, HERR, BEI DEINEM WORTSolfa PDF

Translations
